items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: The first time I met Illinois Jacquet and Clean Head and them, they were playing the Milton Larkins band in Houston, Texas.

ctx.x: Did Earl's band ever go South?

Oh, we played a lot of Southern dates but it wasn't no mixed band. Oh, yeah. Man, we lived in the South. The first time I met Illinois Jacquet and Clean Head and them, they were playing the Milton Larkins band in Houston, Texas. Yeah. This is early '30's. And they had a good band. Used to -- that was a good band that Milton had. They was blowing then, you know, way back there then. But I met those guys, I met Al Hibbler down in San Antonio, Texas. And then I also met Al in Little Rock, Arkansas. That's the --
That's where he's from -- isn't it?
